teams.detail: Lost to Orioles; Cole Young and Canzone homered. 38-37, 1st in AL West. Next: vs Red Sox.
Finished 60-22 (best in East), lost to Cavs in 7. Hold pick No. 21 in the June 23 draft.
Super Bowl LX champs; ring ceremony June 11, mandatory minicamp wrapped. Camp opens next month.
Spring done (Purple beat Gold 27-10); Fisch calls plays in 2026. Opens vs WSU Apple Cup Sept 5.
Big Ten offseason; reshaping the roster via the portal ahead of 2026-27.

headlines.headline: JUST 71 EARLY ENTRANTS FOR 2026 DRAFT, FEWEST IN TWO DECADES
headlines.detail: NIL money pulled stars back to campus, headlined by freshmen AJ Dybantsa (BYU), Darryn Peterson (Kansas) and Cameron Boozer (Duke). The draft runs June 23-24 at Barclays Center.

headlines.headline: KNICKS WIN FIRST TITLE IN 53 YEARS, BEAT SPURS 4-1
headlines.detail: New York closed out San Antonio for its first championship since 1973 and paraded down the Canyon of Heroes on June 18. Attention turns to the June 23-24 draft and free agency.

headlines.headline: BLOCKBUSTER TRADES RESHAPE ROSTERS AS MINICAMPS WRAP
headlines.detail: A June 1 swap sent Myles Garrett to the Rams and A.J. Brown to the Patriots; the Falcons added Chiefs tackle Wanya Morris. Camps open in under two months.

headlines.headline: TRANSFER PORTAL CLOSES; SORSBY EXITS, LSU LANDS TOP CLASS
headlines.detail: The 2026 portal window shut with ~3,665 players in and 76% committed. Texas Tech QB Brendan Sorsby parted ways with the program; Lane Kiffin's LSU built a top transfer class.
